name: e-Shram
description: Explain the process, pre-fill details, open e-Shram at the right step, track status and remind
notes: Info + pre-fill + deep link; no login automation

steps: Keep Aadhaar, PAN and a recent photo ready
OTPs come to your Aadhaar-linked mobile; you type them, never Santosh
Santosh fills what it can from your profile and tracks the application number
